text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
"W-W-Why?! After writing all that?!\nWhy 
can't you give it to them?!"

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
"How dreadful...\nAre you saying the pure 
melodia you played was a falsehood?"

text_block_list.name: Troubled Student
text_block_list.text:
"N-No, that's not it... But... I just 
can't imagine\nthat someone like me 
pouring out my feelings would make my 
senpai happy...!"

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
"N-No way...! To have feelings you want to 
express,\nand not express them... That 
means—"

text_block_list.name: Suzuka & Fukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"'Good morning, Taiki.'\n'Good morning, 
Taiki-san!'"

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: ...Uh-huuuh?

text_block_list.name: Suzuka & Fukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"'Happy birthday, Taiki.'\n'Happy 
birthday!'"

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: ...Uh-huh!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: "NOOOOOOOO!?!? That's no good!!"

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
"If you really won't give it to them, no 
matter what...\nthen this letter... I 
will. I will—"

text_block_list.name: Troubled Student
text_block_list.text:
"Huh? W-Wait... Taiki-san, are you going 
to deliver it to my senpai...?!"

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
"NO! This letter...\nI will enjoy eating 
it up myself!"

text_block_list.name: Everyone
text_block_list.text: "Whaaaat!?!?"

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
"H-Hey, hold on?! What are you doing, 
Taiki?!\nWait up!"

text_block_list.name: Troubled Student
text_block_list.text: "M-My precious, heartfelt feelings—!?!?"

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
"Come on, come on, come on! If you don't 
catch up,\nI'm really gonna eat the whole 
thing up, you know?!"

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
"Haa... haa... You're a stayer, aren't 
you...\nMy stamina is completely 
drained..."

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
"...See how many precious feelings are 
packed inside this letter?\nBecause of 
that... you really have to deliver it!"

text_block_list.name: Troubled Student
text_block_list.text:
"Th-That's...! ...That might be true, 
but...!\nI just don't have the confidence 
that they'll be happy about it...!"

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
"...Listen to me for a second, 
please.\nConveying your most special 
feelings—"

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: "—is like a TACKLE!!"

text_block_list.name: Troubled Student
text_block_list.text: "Huh?! A... A tackle?!"

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
"YES! In other words, a special move! It's 
not about 'wondering if they'll be 
happy'...\nYou MAKE them happy! With all 
your full power!"

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
"The feeling of liking someone, of 
cherishing them!\nThere's no way anyone in 
the world wouldn't be happy to receive 
that!!"

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
"If you tell her your true feelings, 
she'll definitely be thrilled!! 
If there's any problem, it's just whether 
or not you can express them clearly!"

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
"I've run alongside you, so I can 
guarantee it! 
Your feelings have plenty of power to 
reach her!"

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
"...If it were me... and someone cared so 
deeply for me 
but never told me, I'd feel so very 
lonely!"

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
"So... please unleash it! Your 
feelings—your special move! 
A tackle, a shot, or... a slash! Whichever 
you prefer...!"

text_block_list.name: Troubled Student
text_block_list.text:
"...... Do you think... my tackle... 
can blow Senpai's heart away...?"

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: YES!!!!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
"To speak or not to speak... The destino 
is 
right now in your very hands."

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
"However—if our ensemble has given you 
even the slightest bit of courage..."

text_block_list.name: Untroubled Student
text_block_list.text:
"...... Understood...! My feelings... my 
special move... 
I will unleash them upon Senpai!!"

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
"Oh...! Thank you! I am so happy! 
HUG TIME!"

text_block_list.name: Untroubled Student
text_block_list.text: Guh-ack!?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: ...I see. So that was it.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: (...Taiki... and Earth too... are truly—)

text_block_list.name: Untroubled Student
text_block_list.text: Gwagh, gack...!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
"W-Wait, Taiki! 
Let her go already!!"

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
"Here goes! This is our combined 
collaborative wrapping technique! 
The Musical Note Thousand Origami Cranes 
Grand Universe Wrapping!!"

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
"Upon opening the box, a thousand cranes 
adorned with musical notes will take 
flight— 
Ah! Molto brillante...!"

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"How about that! With this, there's no 
mistaking 
how extra-serious your feelings are~!"

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
...... Right. It really is quite 
wonderful.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
"What matters most, surely, is the sincere 
desire 
to make them happy and convey your 
feelings."

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
"Even if the outside looks a little 
eccentric or over-the-top... 
if it overflows with genuine emotion, 
then..."

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
"WOO! Suzuka's stamp of approval!! 
Then there's definitely no mistake!"

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: ...Fufu.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: Sphera. ...Everyone is a "supernova."

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: Neo Universe will... "ACTI" as well.
